description: Defines the app_executor_metrics_service class and related classes/functions for managing executor metrics sessions, including starting/stopping backend, creating sessions, and building the service with configuration.

classes.name: app_executor_metrics_service
classes.description: Manages executor metrics sessions, controls backend start/stop, and provides access to metrics channel registry.

classes.name: executor_metrics_manager
classes.description: Controls the operation of the executor metrics backend, including start and stop.

classes.name: executor_metrics_session
classes.description: RAII class managing the lifetime of an executor metrics session.

classes.name: session_close_callback
classes.description: Callback invoked on session destruction to close the session.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Creates a new executor metrics session if none is active.

methods.name: create_dummy_session
methods.description: Creates a dummy session that does not start a metrics manager.
